2. sentences.text: In view of the above said facts, the claimants have filed I.A.No. 1 of 2021 before the Land Acquisition Tribunal to terminate the proceedings arising under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
However, the said application is being adjourned from time to time for the past 2 years due to the delay on the part of the acquisition authorities.

Hence, he has prayed for early disposal of I.A.No.1 of 2021.
4.
